revision.hashCaveat: Hashes captured after successful runs, not atomically at process launch; sources unchanged since corresponding tests.

scope: Real isolated synthetic MySQL adapter tests, not packaged JAR/API/UI/company database acceptance.

execution.runtimeCompilation: Current adapters, fixture and four supporting application types compiled to private temporary classes; no target/classes dependency.
execution.unitCompilation: Current adapters and MysqlReadClientTest compiled to private temp classes with cached dependencies and existing target/classes for supporting types; direct JUnit Platform launcher.
execution.environment: macOS x86_64; Anaconda MySQL 8.4.0; Connector/J 9.7.0; Java 21

changes: Every selected value, regardless of cached numeric/temporal/text type, uses LEFT(CONVERT(column USING utf8mb4), max(1,maxBytes/4/columnCount)). One CHAR_LENGTH comparison flag accompanies each value. Original prepared equality predicates remain unchanged.
Metadata returns COALESCE(CHAR_LENGTH(GENERATION_EXPRESSION),0)>0 rather than the expression text.
Uniform character projection preserves JSON strings for numbers/date/time and JSON null; very small budgets may truncate any value with explicit flag.
Exact-case fail-closed checks remain unchanged; no Fermat-owned service edits.

observedConcurrentDdl.injection: Separate disposable account changes body INT to LONGTEXT and writes 8 MiB after production metadata statement closes, before target SELECT.
observedConcurrentDdl.observedOutcome: MySQL error 1412 (table definition changed); no returned value payload. Production surfaces sanitized failure, not an automatic retry.
observedConcurrentDdl.freshExplicitTransaction: Reads the changed LONGTEXT as a bounded prefix with truncated=true, one complete serialized row.
observedConcurrentDdl.scopeCaveat: This real server did not return stale-schema rows: it rejected the race. The stale-numeric metadata bounded-projection path is additionally covered by unit assertions. No claim that all MySQL configurations behave identically.

results.metadata: All observed generation-expression flags are at most one returned byte; generated columns remain rejected.

bounds.textualValuePayloadPerRow: <= maxBytes (64..65536), independently of cached type; plus one byte per selected-column flag, up to 16. Protocol/metadata overhead additional.
bounds.rows: <= requested limit + 1, maximum 201. Completed serialized rows counted; incomplete rows not counted.
bounds.wireMethod: Forwarding JDBC field byte observations and SHOW SESSION STATUS Bytes_sent around actual production SELECT; includes status/metadata overhead, not TLS packet capture.
bounds.time: Version 60s, compile 30s, initialization 120s, readiness 60s, fixture 45s, overall 300s; TERM then KILL after 5s. DDL fixture statement timeout 3s. Server scan/conversion cost is not bounded by returned byte limit.

safety.credentials: Only freshly generated local fixture credentials; none retained here. Extra DDL account has ALTER/UPDATE/SELECT only on disposable drift_items. Investigation account stays SELECT-only.
safety.isolation: No-defaults, private temp datadir/profile/socket/log, random loopback port, no services/default DB/user data.
safety.cleanup: Successful runner terminated owned server and deleted private data and generated credentials.
remainingHazards: This fixes wire bounding under type drift; concurrent replacement with a view/generated column remains a separate metadata-policy race not solved or certified here.
Case variants may be rejected even where MySQL accepts them.
No full attack/state-diff matrix, 429/retry/pagination, UI/final-answer completeness or hard stalled-I/O proof.
